**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-5687128, Reactome:R-HSA-450408, Reactome:R-HSA-4420097, Reactome:R-HSA-9009391)

**Proposed mechanism:** Pathogenic variant in HSPB1 —DISRUPTS→ HSPB1 (HGNC:4855); HSPB1 (HGNC:4855) —DISRUPTS→ HSPB1-mediated chaperone activity (GO:0008354); HSPB1-mediated chaperone activity (GO:0008354) —LEADS_TO→ Distal lower limb muscle weakness (HP:0007340); HSPB1-mediated chaperone activity (GO:0008354) —LEADS_TO→ Foot deformities (HP:0001771). **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism involving HSPB1's chaperone function opens avenues for therapeutic strategies targeting protein folding and neuronal support, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.
